name: Rob Booker ADX Breakout: low-ADX 20-bar box break with box-width targets
author: Rob Booker (V5 update by community)
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
entry_long: ADX(14,14) < 18 AND close crosses above the 20-bar highest high (box upper, from prior bar) while flat.
entry_short: ADX < 18 AND close crosses below the 20-bar lowest low.
exit: Take profit = entry + 1.0 x box width; stop loss = entry - 0.5 x box width (box width = upper - lower of the box at entry).
position_sizing: cash 100000 default qty value in strategy()
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Box levels freeze while a position is open.
